 ◆ sshTermy  vdev Idea: Dominik Bornhäußer                                                     ● AI






  ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │ Network scan: find SSH devices                                                               │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ ▌ Subnet              192.0.2.0/24                                                           │
  │                       e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 · 10.0.0.10-50 · several separated by commas (at   │
  │ most 4096 addresses)                                                                         │
  │   Port                22                                                                     │
  │   User                                                                                       │
  │   Login                agent  keyfile  password                                              │
  │   Folder              Network scan                                                           │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Only the open SSH port and the SSH banner are checked (no login).                            │
  │ Switches and routers (Aruba, Cisco, MikroTik …) are recognized by their banner.              │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Ctrl+S or ⏎ in the last field starts the scan                                                │
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯






 Tab next  ←/→ select  Ctrl+S start scan  Esc cancel  F1 Help
